name: Flatlined World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Four men held it in four months. Takeo Brown had it on New Year's Day 2003 and Liphe Gonne took it off him on the same card; Javier Garcia took it from Gonne at Pride & Victory that February; and Frank Minio took it from Garcia on fightSHOW: 015 on 23 April, with a right fist thrown to counter a blow that would have won the fight. Garcia stayed on his feet after being knocked out and challenged for it again before he left the cage, for a CLASH in May whose date the fed never announced.

name: Flatlined World Lightweight Championship
notes: The fed's own Current Champions page of February 2003 lists the belt with N/A where the champion's name goes (/promotions/ff/archive/current-champions-2003-02.html); its own title history, captured that April, records one holder (/promotions/ff/archive/title-history-2003-04.html).
epitaph: Vacant on the fed's own Current Champions page in February 2003, and won six weeks later by Chester Ramis, a heavyweight who had spent a chapter working out that a week of illness and five lost pounds were about to drop him a weight class. He is the only champion it ever had.
